//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Manure -> Config

Enable Manure.//: Whether Manure is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

manureDropDelayTicks.//: How long the delay in ticks is in between loaded animals dropping manure. 20 ticks = 1 second. By default twice a day, every 12000 ticks. min: 0, max: 10,000,000
